programme.desc: For at bevise sit værd risikerer en tidligere filmhelt alt. I sin kamp mod forskelige kritikere, et alter ego, sin datter og en skuespiller stræber han efter at komme ud af middelmådigheden.

programme.title: Vores livs ferie

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber

programme.title: Upside of Anger

programme.title: Taken 2

programme.title: Andromeda: Ind i labyrinten

programme.title: Mutant X: tegn fra oven

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvede Promo
programme.desc: Kom indenfor, hvis du tør. Om dagen besøger vi ekstreme samlere og spøgelsesjagere, mens vi om aften skruer op for uhyggen med gyserfilm og træder indenfor i de mest rædselsvækkende, hjemsøgte huse. Filmene starter hver dag kl. 22.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Bulkeley Hotel
programme.desc: The former home of Queen Victoria is now home to many spirits who have been seen by guests and staff. Witness the first ever formal documentation of the paranormal activities in the Bulkeley Hotel.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Plas Teg
programme.desc: The county of Flintshire in Wales is said to be a land filled with ghosts and haunts. Plas Teg is said to be one of the "most haunted" houses in the area. With over 400 years of history, this place is sure to be the home of many an entity.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Augusta is home to Kentucky’s oldest jail, which housed prisoners since the early 1800s and still sits upon its original foundation today. While it now operates as a museum, there have been numerous guests who have claimed to see unexplainable things.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvede Promo
programme.desc: Kom indenfor, hvis du tør. Om dagen besøger vi ekstreme samlere og spøgelsesjagere, mens vi om aften skruer op for uhyggen med gyserfilm og træder indenfor i de mest rædselsvækkende, hjemsøgte huse. Filmene starter hver dag kl. 22.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The oldest, and longest running movie theatre in Kentucky is now owned and operated by someone who never once thought about ghosts. However, a shocking experience with a woman dressed in white altered his belief in the supernatural forever.

programme.title: The Raven (1963)
programme.desc: The sorcerer Craven learns from fellow magician Dr. Bedlo that his supposedly dead wife is alive and living at the castle of master sorcerer Dr. Scarabus. The film is presented without local subtitles.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: Colette
programme.desc: I 1900-tallets Paris presses Colette af sin mand til at skrive bøger i hans navn. Da bøgerne bliver en succes, forråder han hende, og hun må kæmpe for at få en stemme i en mandsdomineret forfatterverden samt den anerkendelse, som hun fortjener.

programme.title: On the road
programme.desc: Dean og Sal er unge, oprørske amerikanere i 1940’erne. De nægter at indordne sig under samfundets konformitet og i deres søgen efter en identitet tager de på road-trip tværs over USA.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: My Best Friend's Girl
programme.desc: Tank (Dane Cook) står over for den ultimative venskabsprøve, da hans bedste ven (Jason Biggs) hyrer ham til at tage hans eks (Kate Hudson) med på en skidt date for at få hende til at indse, hvor god en kæreste han er.

programme.title: Også engle spiser bønner
programme.desc: Charlie er fribryder i forbudstidens New York, og han nægter at være med til at fikse en kamp, og gangsterbossen Angelo har satset penge på modstanderen. Han bliver nødt til at flygte, og under flugten støder han på Sonny, der også er på flugt.

programme.title: Notorious
programme.desc: Datteren af en dømt nazistisk spion bliver bedt af amerikanske agenter om at indsamle oplysninger om en ring af nazistiske videnskabsmænd i Sydamerika. Hvor langt skal hun gå for at infiltrere dem?

programme.title: Explorers
programme.desc: In their makeshift laboratory, three boys use an amazing discovery and their ingenuity to build their own spaceship and launch themselves on a fantastic interplanetary journey.

programme.title: Fortress: Sniper's Eye
programme.desc: Den pensionerede CIA-agent Robert kaster sig ud i en vovemodig redningsaktion af sin ærkefjendes enke, Sasha. Men snart konfronteres Robert med et velkendt ansigt, som han troede, han aldrig skulle se igen...

programme.title: Behaving Badly
programme.desc: Rick Stevens er villig til at gøre alt for at vinde Nina Penningtons hjerte. Selv hvis det betyder at indgå et væddemål med en gangster søn.

programme.title: Farvel til mafiaen
programme.desc: En mafia boss og hans familie er flyttet til en søvnig by i Frankrig, som en del af vidne beskyttelsesprogrammet, efter de vidnede mod mafiaen.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Under et arbejde bliver Shalimar såret og får hjælp af en anden vild mutant, Nikki, som hun kendte og næsten var blevet valgt til holdet. Mens Shalimar kommer til hægterne, tilbyder hun at vikariere.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Dødens Dolk
programme.desc: Indien, 500 e.Kr: En kostbar dolk bruges til menneskeofringer til gudinden Kali. Sydney skal returnere et levn til Indien for sin jægerkollega, som tror, at dolken fik ham til at dræbe sin assistent.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Mochicas sidste
programme.desc: På jagt efter et sydamerikansk mochica-indisk relikvie til beskyttelse bliver Nigel og hans kolleger taget til fange af lokale guerillaer. Det er op til Sydney og hans allierede Jason Clark at redde dem.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Frugtbar jord
programme.desc: Sydney genforenes med sin high school-kæreste for at finde et hawaiiansk frugtbarhedsidol i Madagaskar.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Gypsy Jigsaw
programme.desc: Sydney modtager et sæt sjældne tarotkort fra sin nyligt afdøde veninde. Den berygtede, hidtil uomtalte Vulture var efter ham. Sydney får Claudia til at hjælpe.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Boston, FBI agents and local police tracked a gang of robbers who specialized in armored car takedowns. Their MO was familiar. The gang used precise timing to steal millions in cash and burned their getaway cars to destroy evidence.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the late 1970s, the FBI had a working knowledge of anti-Castro terrorists operating in the United States. But then a new group appeared, more violent and aggressive than their predecessors.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Betrayed
programme.desc: Sometimes when a death seems to be accidental or the result of a tragic accident, it is up to forensic scientists to reveal the deception lying just below the surface.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Elements Of Murder
programme.desc: There are several things that can suggest murder; jealousy, anger, poison. When everyday substances reveal hidden clues that break a homicide case, those substances become the elements of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Random Targets
programme.desc: Most victims of multiple murderers are meticulously chosen because of a mutual connection with the killer or because they match an intricate set of criteria that fits the killer's MO.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Grave Secrets
programme.desc: Killers often attempt to deflect attention away from their crimes by hiding the remains of their victims. Bodies may lay hidden for years before they are discovered.

programme.title: The New Detectives: At Close Range
programme.desc: When a victim is gunned down at point-blank range, police often assume that a friend or acquaintance is to blame.

programme.desc: Two desperate parents were given an antique cradle by a sympathetic Lewis Vendredi. The cradle belonged to a female passenger aboard the Titanic.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: A longtime fixture of the paranormal investigative landscape, Mackey’s has developed a reputation for being one of America’s creepiest haunts, supposedly hosting a dark energy that can leave some investigators mentally scarred.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Kentucky is home to a slew of purportedly haunted locations, with some that are more notorious than others. By all local accounts, the Benton farmhouse should be considered one of the state’s most significant haunts.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvede Promo
programme.desc: Kom indenfor, hvis du tør. Om dagen besøger vi ekstreme samlere og spøgelsesjagere, mens vi om aften skruer op for uhyggen med gyserfilm og træder indenfor i de mest rædselsvækkende, hjemsøgte huse. Filmene starter hver dag kl. 22.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Joan Osbourne, Ahmad Rashad, Mia Tyler, Renee Taylor
programme.desc: Joan Osborne is attacked by the ghost of a woman with a painful history.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Chaka Khan, Kristin Bauer, Iqbal Theba
programme.desc: Chaka Khan is saved by a guardian angel; Kristin Bauer comes face to face with the spirit of her father; and Iqbal Theba is terrorized by a demonic spirit.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvede Promo
programme.desc: Kom indenfor, hvis du tør. Om dagen besøger vi ekstreme samlere og spøgelsesjagere, mens vi om aften skruer op for uhyggen med gyserfilm og træder indenfor i de mest rædselsvækkende, hjemsøgte huse. Filmene starter hver dag kl. 22.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Mickey Rooney, Brande Roderick, Eric Mabius, Kim Coles
programme.desc: Mickey Rooney receives a life-changing message from the other side. A demonic entity terrorizes Brande Roderick throughout her life. Eric Mabius discovers the tragic past.

programme.title: White Zombie
programme.desc: A plantation owner desires another man's bride and enlists the help of a witch doctor to use a mind-control potion to make her fall in love with him. Instead, the witch doctor turns against them both.

programme.title: Dark Star DA
programme.desc: Vi er i midten af det 21. århundarede, og mennesket har udforsket hele solsystemet. Kolonister har forladt Jorden for at finde nye hjem i universet. Det bevæbnede rumskib "Dark Star" skal bane vej for alle disse fredelige kolonister.

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: Teaching Mrs. Tingle
programme.desc: Leigh Anns (Katie Holmes) drømme om et legat ødelægges, da hendes lærer, fru Tingle, med urette beskylder hende for at snyde. Da hun er desperat for at bevise sin uskyld, lægger Leigh Ann planer, der skal lære fru Tingle en lektie.

programme.title: Capote
programme.desc: In 1959, Truman Capote, learns about the horrific and senseless murder of a family of four in Kansas. As he digs deeper into the story, he is inspired to expand the project into what would be his greatest work, In Cold Blood.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Backstage Murder
programme.desc: In the 1980's, two partners created a nightclub that would bring them wealth and international fame. The male strip club phenomenon promised female patrons fun and excitement. But the bright lights hid a dark side.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hidden Agenda
programme.desc: Across the Midwest, a band of armed robbers struck banks at the rate of nearly one per month. They attacked with lightning precision and lethal force. They were in and out in five minutes.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Women are most often assaulted by someone they know. Near Las Vegas in December of 2000 a young woman became the latest victim of a violent sex offender. Before authorities could locate him, he would add murder to his list of crimes.

programme.title: Defiance
programme.desc: An out-of work merchant seaman single-handedly tames a powerful street gang ("The Souls") that has been terrorizing his neighborhood on New York City's Lower East Side.

programme.title: Magic in the Moonlight
programme.desc: Stanley Crawford (Colin Firth) er tryllekunstner, men skeptisk overfor det overnaturlige. Han møder den clairvoyante Sophie Baker (Emma Stone) og skal afsløre hendes tricks, men kan ikke finde nogen. Er der mon mere mellem himmel og jord?

programme.title: Vores livs ferie
programme.desc: Oplev de to Oscarvindere, Helen Mirren og Donald Sutherland, i en forrygende og moden roadmovie, der både leverer gode grin og stof til eftertanke.

programme.title: Fingrene væk fra øen
programme.desc: Terence Hill og Bud Spencer er tilbage i den vildeste skattejagtskomedie. I håbet om at finde en begravet skat på en øde ø, prøver Hill at stikke af med Spencers båd, men efter et slagsmål ender de begge i vandet.

programme.title: What's Eating Gilbert Grape
programme.desc: Gilbert Grape (Johnny Depp) bor i Endora, hvor der ikke sker ret meget. Han er ansvarlig for at passe på sin autistiske bror Arnie (Leonardo DiCaprio). En dag kommer Becky til byen, og Gilbert bliver forelsket, men det er svært at få lidt privatliv.

programme.title: 24 Hours to Live
programme.desc: Travis Conrad, som er tidligere elitesoldat, er tynget af sorg over tabet af sin hustru og sin lille søn, da en tidligere soldaterkammerat, Jim Morrow, dukker op med et farligt og lukrativt jobtilbud.

programme.title: Setup
programme.desc: De tre venner Vincent, Sonny og Dave planlægger et stort diamantkup. Men Vincent har brug for alle pengene selv og skyder de to andre. Dog overlever Sonny og vil have hævn.

programme.title: Andromeda: Bunker Hill
programme.desc: Dylan og hans nye flåde fra Commonwealth tager kampen op mod Drago-Kazov-flåden, men finder den meget større end forventet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ouroboros
programme.desc: Magog-æggene i Harper er begyndt at klække, så holdet bygger en Tesseract-maskine.

programme.title: Andromeda: Lava og raketter
programme.desc: Dylan overtager en turistbåd i et forsøg på at undslippe lejesoldaterne.

programme.title: Andromeda: Alle mine synder skal huskes
programme.desc: En identifikation af et lig går galt, da det viser sig, at Bekas tidligere besætningsmedlem ikke er død.

programme.title: Mutant X

programme.desc: Andromeda har til oppgave å eskortere medisinske skip trygt gjennom Drago-Kazov-rommet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Hjemmebranner
programme.desc: En planet av Commonwealth-overlevende ledet av Dylans tidligere forlovede blir invitert til å bli med i det nye Commonwealth, men når de stemmer for ikke å bli med, blir Magog mistenkt for å ha spilt skittent.

programme.title: Andromeda: Inn i labyrinten
programme.desc: En avgrunnsagent prøver å lokke Harper til å bli med i Magog

programme.title: Andromeda: Prinsen
programme.desc: Når de redder en ung prins fra et opprør som dreper resten av familien hans, blir Dylan og Tyr bedt om å være hans rådgivere.

programme.title: Mutant X: Crossroads of the Soul
programme.desc: Teamet tar sikte på å redde Brennan, som har blitt fanget inne i en usynlig by og står overfor henrettelse for en forbrytelse han ikke begikk.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programme.desc: A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dead Run
programme.desc: In Pennsylvania, an inmate escaped with the help of his female accomplice. Following a trail of fraudulent credit card receipts and deaths, authorities track the pair, but always find themselves one step behind.

programme.title: The FBI Files: First and Kennedy Street Crew
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, Washington, D.C., became the murder capital of the nation. Few were left untouched by gang violence, which was ignited by the drug trade. By 1994, that violence would strike at the very heart of law enforcement.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Witness To Terror
programme.desc: Black Boxes: Little evidence is left after an airplane takes a deadly plunge from the sky. Investigators' best hope for an answer comes from the flight data recorder known as a black box.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murder For Hire
programme.desc: For some killers, murder can be a profitable business. And the scene of the crime can be both a source for clues, and puzzling questions. When a victim has been targeted for death, investigators must look beyond the obvious to uncover a murder for hire.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Buried Secrets
programme.desc: Forensic scientists find clues written in blood as they investigate the deaths of three women killed by the men who once loved them.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Aim
programme.desc: Ballistic analysis is the key to finding killers who turn guns on their victims. Each shot fired leaves its own "fingerprint", allowing scientists to target murderers with deadly aim.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bad Medicine
programme.desc: Drug trafficking has spawned a violent and deadly criminal underground. It's providing a challenge to forensic investigators devoted to cracking drug rings.

programme.desc: Butt-head tries some sadistic home remedies in an attempt to stop Beavis's nosebleed. / When Beavis turns into Cornholio in Burger World, Immigration Officials take him in as a possible illegal alien and try to make sense of his gibberish.

programme.desc: Beavis & Butt-head explore the career possibilities in selling blood. / While causing mischief at a drive-in movie theatre, Beavis & Butt-head experience a new phase of the moon.

programme.desc: Suffering from nasty colds, Beavis & Butt-head visit a doctor in hopes of glomming a prescription remedy. / Beavis & Butt-head's school assignment is to write a poem in the venerated Haiku format.

programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-head get to look at real nudes. / The return of Lolita and Tanqueray! Beavis and Butt-head go on their first date, well, almost.

programme.title: Mike Judge's Beavis & Butt-Head: To teite menn / Fredagsgalskap
programme.desc: Middelaldrende Beavis og Butt-Head oppfyller sin samfunnsplikt som jurymedlemmer./ Beavis og Butt-Head tror feilaktig at de har byttet kropp.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Car Wash / Kidnapped
programme.desc: Beavis & Butt-head attempt to make some money washing cars. / Beavis & Butt-head decide that kidnapping Stewart would be a quick way to some cash.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Politically Correct / True Crime
programme.desc: To better understand their female classmates, Beavis & Butt-head must get in touch with their feelings. Huh huh, he said "touch." / Beavis & Butt-head unknowingly star in their favorite crime reenactment shows.

programme.desc: Beavis starts mimicing Butt-Head / A quiet day in Highland, Texas / Our duo enrolls in a fitness class

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Scared Straight / Citizen Butt-head Part 2
programme.desc: To teach them that crime doesn't pay, Beavis & Butt-head's principal sends them to prison for a day. Bad idea. / Beavis & Butt-head and President Clinton explore chaos theory together.

programme.title: RENO 911!: The Prefect of Wanganui
programme.desc: Kimball and Dangle escort the Prefect of Wanganui, Reno's sister city, around town; Junior and Wiegel struggle to stand out at the high school job fair.

programme.title: RENO 911!: ...And the Installation Is Free
programme.desc: Jones discovers the delights of fame after doing radio commercials for a carpeting company.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Clemmy Marries a Dead Guy
programme.desc: Johnson tries to marry the late Hot Tub King of Reno, and Garcia and Williams discover the magical properties of Liberace's piano.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Garcia's Secret Girlfriend
programme.desc: Dangle and the gang solve Reno's biggest mystery: who is Garcia's new girlfriend?

programme.title: RENO 911!: Dangle's Son
programme.desc: While Dangle spends time with a beautiful young man who might be his son, the other deputies enjoy the new department Humvee.

programme.title: RENO 911!: CSI: Reno
programme.desc: The deputies work as security guards when "CSI: Miami" comes to Reno, and Wiegel and Dangle get a homeless man into a bathtub.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Naked Stake-Out
programme.desc: After a drug sting goes wrong, Dangle and Junior race back to the station on foot -- and naked.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Wiegel and Craig Get Married
programme.desc: Good news and bad news for Wiegel: her boyfriend proposed, but he's going to be executed for multiple murders.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Time Enough at Last
programme.desc: A bank teller, Henry Bemis, longs for time alone to read books. He gets his wish...

programme.title: Z for Zachariah
programme.desc: I etterkant av av en verdensomspennende atomkrig er Ann Burden (Margot Robbie) en overlevende. Ann frykter lenge at hun er det eneste gjenlevende mennesket på jorden, inntil hun oppdager noe helt forbløffende: et annen menneske.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Nightmare at 20,000 Feet
programme.desc: Mr. Wilson believes he sees a gremlin on the wing of the commercial aircraft he is taking back home... from the sanitarium, where he has been committed for six months after a mental breakdown during a similar flight.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Night Call
programme.desc: Mysterious phone calls haunt a disabled woman.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Nervous Man in a Four Dollar Room
programme.desc: Small time criminal Jackie Rhoades must face both his past and his conscience while waiting for his next assignment.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Carnfield Hall
programme.desc: Carnfield Hall is a country house dating from the 15th and 16th Centuries. This private residence turn event hall is using its paranormal activity to draw in business. Are these spirits the old residents?

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Further immersing themselves into Harlan county, the team investigates an active coal mine, Portal 31, and speaks with its manager about his own paranormal claims both inside the mine and in Lynch, Kentucky.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Benham, Kentucky’s idyllic, small-town aesthetic belies its dark and bloody past, rife with greed and conflict. There are many who believe the community is living under the shadow of a mountain that bore witness to an evil supernatural occurrence.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Brandon, Mustafa, Malia, and Kevin engage in a roundtable discussion highlighting their most shocking finds and new data that they’ve gathered across their numerous investigations.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: A longtime grudge between two families linked by a brutal mob revenge killing persists in the historic Scott County Jail, whose current caretakers have transformed it into a paranormal research center.

programme.title: Dark Star NO
programme.desc: Det er midten av 2000-tallet, og mennesket har utforsket hele solsystemet. Kolonister har forlatt jorden for å finne nye hjem i universet. Det væpnede romskipet "Dark Star" skal bane vei for alle de fredelige kolonistene.

programme.title: The Raven (1963)
programme.desc: The sorcerer Craven learns from fellow magician Dr. Bedlo that his supposedly dead wife is alive and living at the castle of master sorcerer Dr. Scarabus. The film is presented without local subtitles.

programme.title: Ondt blod i sauedalen
programme.desc: Colin og Les avler prisvinnende sauer på en gård i et lite australsk samfunn. Når en sykdom sprer seg blant dyrene og myndighetene bestemmer at alle sauene i dalen må avlives, må mennene samarbeide for å redde levebrødet.

programme.title: What's Eating Gilbert Grape
programme.desc: Gilbert føler seg innesperret, i en kjedelig amerikansk småby, med ansvar for sin autistiske lillebror og bevegelseshemmete mor. Men en dag kommer Becky til byen, og snart oppstår det et skjørt og spesielt vennskap dem imellom.

programme.title: Hackers
programme.desc: A neophyte hacker becomes the target of the FBI after he unknowingly taps into a high-tech embezzling scheme which could cause a horrific environmental disaster in this suspenseful drama.

programme.title: Fantomet
programme.desc: Historien begynner når en ekspedisjon går i land på øya Bengalla på leting etter Tougandas hodeskaller. Med sin evne til å styre energi kan de bli en katastrofe for menneskeheten.

programme.title: Two Is Family
programme.desc: Samuel har et bekymringsløst liv på den franske rivieraen. Det er før Kristin, en tidligere flamme, kunngjør at han er far til en nyfødt, gir ham en babyjente og stikker!

programme.title: A Merry Holiday
programme.desc: Christy, en svært vellykket selger, stresser med å få en stor avtale. For å hjelpe henne må hun slå seg sammen med Jonathan som er opptatt med å lage en magisk jul for kjæresten sin. Konflikten er gitt, men noe annet begynner også å gry...

programme.title: 97 Minutes
programme.desc: Et kapret fly vil styrte om bare 97 minutter når det går tom for drivstoff. NSA-direktøren vil at flyet skal skytes ned før den tid, og overlater skjebnen til de uskyldige passasjerene til en hemmelig Interpol-agent.

programme.title: Fortress
programme.desc: Den tidligere CIA-agenten Robert bor på et hemmelig feriested for tidligere spioner. Nå er hans sønn Paul havnet i trøbbel og trenger hans hjelp. Dessverre er ikke Pauls planer så hemmelige som livet til faren.

programme.title: Paris, Texas
programme.desc: Paris, Texas er antagelig Wim Wenders mest kjente, kritikerroste og suksessfulle film, belønnet med flere internasjonale priser inkludert Gullpalmen i Cannes i 1984. Filmen forteller historien om Travis, en mann fortapt i sitt eget private helvete.

programme.title: Girls Just Want to Have Fun
programme.desc: Velkommen til en katolsk jenteskole i hjertet av Chicago, hjemstedet til USAs favorittdanseshow: Dance TV! Utvekslingsstudenten Janey Glenn er et nervevrak når hun blir introdusert for sine fnisende klassekamerater av den strenge søster Katherine.

programme.title: Mutant X: Sign from Above
programme.desc: Tre utenomjordiske personer som utgjør en alvorlig trussel mot menneskeheten, retter seg mot Shalimar, så teamet satser på å redde henne fra sine onde klør.

programme.title: Mutant X: Body and Soul
programme.desc: En kroppsløs mutant overtar likene til forskjellige mennesker og setter seg for å gå etter de som gjorde dette mot ham. En av dem er en lege som Shalimar liker.

programme.title: Mutant X: Understudy
programme.desc: Mens han er på jobb, blir Shalimar skadet og blir hjulpet av en annen vill mutant, Nikki, som hun kjente og nesten ble valgt for laget. Mens Shalimar blir frisk, tilbyr hun å fylle ut.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Three Rivers to Cross
programme.desc: Ifølge lokale munker er Famed Jade Empress gjemt i dalen som vil bli oversvømmet når Three Rivers Dam flomportene har sin store åpning.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Lost Contact
programme.desc: Sydney, Nigel og milliardærentreprenør Rod Thorson fallskjerm i Myanmar-jungelen for å redde et relikktjaktteam ansatt av Thorson for å finne en eldgammel offerskål.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Coffee Shop Murders
programme.desc: At a coffee shop in Washington, DC, three employees were shot to death. Evidence at the crime scene pointed in many different directions. Was this a hate crime, a robbery gone wrong or an act of cold-blooded vengeance?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dishonored
programme.desc: Shirley Russell was determined enough to reach the rank of Captain in the United States Marine Corps. When this officer turned up missing, her colleagues refused to believe she had gone AWOL. It was unclear whether Captain Shirley Russell was alive.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Evil Intent
programme.desc: Drops of blood and a torn screen were all that's left to tell authorities what happened to a woman in Indiana. The 21 yr. old victim was taken from her home on a spring morning. She appeared to have no real enemies, there was no clear motive.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Deadly Smile

programme.title: The New Detectives: Misplaced Loyalty
programme.desc: In Northern California, a fire rages in the middle of the night. A woman's charred body is discovered in the smoldering aftermath.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Taste of Poison
programme.desc: Poisoners are the most devious of killers, relying on stealth or their victim's trust in order to steal their lives. They're the most dangerous creatures in the world: smart assassins. And they usually don't stop at one kill.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Left At The Scene

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: The Playhouse
programme.desc: Two children trapped in an abusive home stumble upon a cursed playhouse. The playhouse lets them enter a fantastical world of clowns and parties in return for them luring in a child.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: Tree Of Life
programme.desc: An exclusive fertility clinic is much more than it seems. It is run by a cult of female Druids who use a cursed fertility statue to expand their numbers.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: CoCo
programme.desc: Coco Austin (Model/Dancer/Reality show star) returns to her former home in Albuquerque, NM where as a teenager, she was tormented by a dark entity. While exploring the house and its assembled spirits.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Jack Blades
programme.desc: Jack Blades (Night Ranger) returns to the site of the paranormal experience he had at his cousin's residence--an adobe style home in Alamogordo, New Mexico.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: D.B. Sweeney
programme.desc: Actor D.B. Sweeney (Eight Men Out / Cutting Edge) comes back to the haunted motel in Fort Bragg, California where he had a terrifying experience with an evil entity.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Kim Carnes
programme.desc: Kim Carnes (Betty Davis Eyes) returns to her former residence a historic farmhouse in Franklin, TN, which she once shared with a childlike spirit.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Lewis Black, Meshach Taylor, Samantha Harris
programme.desc: Lewis takes a summer job in the Michigan woods and is visited by unseen entities who torment him at night; Meshach is visited by the ghost of an evil child predator.

programme.title: The Ghoul
programme.desc: A fanatical Egyptologist purchases a stolen jewel, believing in its power to restore the dead. The stone is pursued by a zealot determined to return it to the tomb from which it was stolen before it can release its worst power.

programme.title: The Ape
programme.desc: A mad scientist trying to cure polio must obtain human spinal fluid, and resorts to nefarious means by wearing an ape suit to procure victims for his experiment without being detected.

programme.title: White Zombie
programme.desc: A plantation owner desires another man's bride and enlists the help of a witch doctor to use a mind-control potion to make her fall in love with him. Instead, the witch doctor turns against them both.

programme.title: Orange County
programme.desc: Shaun trives som en smart, men ufokusert surfer, helt til han oppdager en roman av den anerkjente forfatteren Martin Skinner. Han blir inspirert, og forlater Orange County for å studere kreativ skriving ved Stanford University.

programme.title: Man On The Moon
programme.desc: Livet og karrieren til den legendariske komikeren Andy Kaufman.

programme.title: Impact Earth
programme.desc: En astronomiprofessor med NASA-bakgrunn gjør en skremmende oppdagelse om at en destruktiv asteroide er på kollisjonskurs med jorda, og han må få familien i trygghet mens han varsler verden om den kommende ødeleggelsen.

programme.title: The Sentinel
programme.desc: Pete Garrison (Douglas), en en gang betrodd agent som nå er på flukt, må kjempe for å frikjenne seg selv, samt stoppe et drapsforsøk på presidenten før det er for sent!

programme.title: Disaster Movie
programme.desc: DISASTER MOVIE fortsetter den komiske nedturen til din yndlingsgruppe med latterlig attraktive 20-åringer. En skjebnesvanger natt prøver de å komme seg i trygghet mens enhver kjent naturkatastrofe, knuser byen og deres vei.

programme.title: Date Movie
programme.desc: Julia Jones jakter intenst på kjærligheten - alltid på feil sted- helt til hun slår kloa idrømmemannen. Men en slu eks, en fjertende katt og eksentriske svigers truer...

programme.title: Wild Target
programme.desc: En iskald leiemorder får sitt liv snudd på hodet når han blir forelsket i sitt mål, en sjarmerende svindler med uventede planer.

programme.title: The Ice Road
programme.desc: Etter at en fjerntliggende diamantgruve kollapser i Nord-Canada tar Mike oppdraget med å lede redningsoperasjonen, og må trosse de brutale naturkreftene i Canadas villmark.

programme.title: Taken 3
programme.desc: Eks-agenten Bryan Mills er forsont med sin tidligere kone, men lykken blir kortvarig når hun brutalt myrdes og han blir beskyldt for udåden.

programme.title: Wim Wenders Collection: Far Away So Close
programme.desc: En gruppe engler i den tyske hovedstaden ser med lengsel på menneskers liv.

programme.title: The Country Girl
programme.desc: Grace Kelly received an Oscar for her portrayal of the wife, and Bing Crosby played an alcoholic, has-been actor. When he is given an opportunity to star in a new musical show, his wife attempts to help him make a comeback.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Cross of Voodoo
programme.desc: Når to studenter på sporet av det haitiske korset i Utu forsvinner i New Orleans, går Sydney og Nigel ned på bukten for å finne dem.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Roman Holiday
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel er på tur, så Claudia bestemmer seg for å hjelpe Sydneys venn Roger med å finne Julius Cæsars rustning, men relikktjakt er ikke hennes talent.

programme.title: Andromeda: Bunker Hill
programme.desc: Dylan og hans nye Commonwealth-flåte tar på seg Drago-Kazov-flåten, men synes den er mye større enn forventet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ouroboros
programme.desc: Magog-eggene i Harper begynner å klekkes, så teamet bygger en Tesseract-maskin

programme.title: Andromeda: Lava og raketter
programme.desc: Dylan overtar en turistpram i et forsøk på å unnslippe leiesoldater.

programme.title: The FBI Files: When Seconds Count
programme.desc: On July 2nd 1994, a 12-year-old girl was abducted from her home in northern California. The FBI knows to act fast, search wide, enlist volunteers. But as the hours slipped by, agents also realized their chances for recovering her alive grew slim.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Vanished
programme.desc: A daring kidnapping and a bizarre ransom note baffled Mississippi authorities. The victim was the wife of a wealthy businessman. A list of 12 names and a few drops of blood were the only clues to her fate.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Unlawful Flight
programme.desc: In Alabama, two desperate criminals fled the custody of a local deputy. Eluding authorities, they made their way across the country in a wave of car theft, abduction, and murder.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Seeds of Destruction
programme.desc: Forensic Botany & Geology: Plants help provide oxygen and nutrients for existence. Soil is the fertilizer of life. Yet both can yield clues to the time and location of a person's death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Web of Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Entomology: Bugs have roamed the earth for 250 million years, but their intimate association with death is just now coming to life.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fateful Twist
programme.desc: A southeastern Virginia community is stunned by a crime no one can believe. A pregnant woman murdered, her baby lost. Across the state, another town feels a similar shock, a brutal, random slaying in a most unexpected setting.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Scent Of The Kill
programme.desc: A dog can be a dead man's best friend. Dogs have been trained to sniff out corpses, drugs, explosives, and missing persons. They're often the first to find the essential clue that sets an investigation in motion.

programme.desc: The Big Apple får problemer når den uødeleggelige galningen Jason Vorhees reiser til New York, og maler byen "rød".

programme.title: Fredag den 13ende del 4
programme.desc: Etter å ha blitt gjenopplivet på likhuset i et sykehus, vender morderen med hockey-maske oppmerksomheten sin mot Jarvis-familien og en gruppe hittil sorgløse tenåringer.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: 13 O'clock
programme.desc: A cursed pocket watch lets its owner stop time for one hour, and a vicious pair of killers get hold of it.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: Hate On Your Dial
programme.desc: Johnny sells a box of junk to a neighbour without checking the Manifest. A cursed antique car radio is among the items sold.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: And Now The News
programme.desc: In an insane asylum, a doctor is using a cursed antique radio to enact miraculous cures on his patients.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: Night Prey
programme.desc: Twenty years ago, a man's fiance was stolen by vampires and transformed into one. Obsessed, he hunts vampires until the modern day.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Dick Cavett, Monica Keena, Ace Young, Paul Iacono
programme.desc: When Dick stumbles upon a mysterious young woman in an old southern mansion, his distressed host exclaims to her father, "Daddy, she's back."

programme.title: The Amityville Horror
programme.desc: En av de best kjente skrekkhistoriene basert på ekte hendelser. Ryan Reynolds og Melissa George spiller i denne intense og skremmende omstarten fra blockbuster-produsent Michael Bay.

programme.title: The Collector
programme.desc: THE COLLECTOR følger opp historien til håndverkeren Arkin, som gjør absolutt alt han kan og mer til for å betale gjelden til sin eks-kone ved å rane hjemmet til sin nye oppdragsgiver.

programme.title: The Devil Bat
programme.desc: Dr. Paul Carruthers is cheated by his employers after developing a new aftershave lotion, so he seeks revenge by using a giant killer bat to kill anyone wearing the lotion.

programme.title: April Fool'S Day
programme.desc: Da Muffy St. John (Deborah Foreman, VALLEY GIRL) inviterte sine college-venner til sine foreldres hjem på en isolert øy for et høydepunkt i livet, glemte hun å fortelle at det mye mulig kunne bli det siste høydepunktet i deres liv.

programme.title: Blacula
programme.desc: The eternally cool William Marshall puts a fresh spin on the age-old legend of the vampire, condemned to wander the Earth with an insatiable lust for blood in "Blacula," often credited as the first African-American horror film.

programme.title: Gallipoli
programme.desc: To unge menn (Mel Gibson og Mark Lee) møtes i den australske hæren i 1915. De krysser kontinenter og store hav, klatrer opp pyramider og vandrer gjennom Egypts gamle sanddyner for å slutte seg til regimentet sitt i slaget ved Gallipoli.

programme.title: Congo
programme.desc: Når en oppdagers leting etter en diamantgruve ender tragisk i Kongo, sender faren og lederen for operasjonen dr. Karen Ross inn i jungelen for å fortsette letingen... kanskje etter sønnen sin. Men definitivt etter diamantene.

programme.title: Hotel Mumbai
programme.desc: Basert på sanne hendelser: Når terrorister angriper Taj Mahal-hotellet, må både ansatte og gjester kjempe for å overleve i en natt med ren terror.

programme.title: Man on Fire
programme.desc: En pensjonert CIA-agent blir livvakten til en italiensk forretningsmann.

programme.title: Youth in Revolt
programme.desc: Michael Cera (SUPERBAD) spiller Nick Twisp. En unik, men elskverdig tenåring med en smak for de sofistikerte tingene i livet. Han forelsker seg i den nydelige og intelligente Sheeni Saunders (Portia Doubleday) på campingferie med familien.

programme.title: What If
programme.desc: Den håpløst romantiske Wallace har droppet ut av medisinstudiet og har brent seg på kjærligheten. Når han møter Chantry, som dessverre er i et forpliktende forhold til kjæresten Ben, oppstår en umiddelbar gnist mellom dem.

programme.title: Fortress: Sniper's Eye
programme.desc: Den pensjonerte CIA-agenten Robert legger ut på en dristig redningsaksjon av erkefiendens enke, Sasha. Men snart blir Robert konfrontert med et kjent ansikt han trodde han aldri ville se igjen...

programme.title: Till Death
programme.desc: Etter en romantisk kveld i deres avsidesliggende hus, våkner Emma opp lenket til sin døde ektemann. Hun er fanget og isolert og må kjempe mot leiemordere for å unnslippe ektemannens avsindige plan.

programme.title: Giallo
programme.desc: En morder herjer i Torino, og en besatt etterforsker må finne ham før hans neste offer lider en grufull skjebne i denne mørke giallo-thrilleren.

programme.title: Very Bad Things
programme.desc: Bryllupsgjester vender seg mot hverandre etter at en prostituert blir drept.

programme.title: Andromeda: Vær alle mine synder husket
programme.desc: En kroppsidentifikasjon går galt når det viser seg at Bekas tidligere mannskap ikke er død.

programme.title: Mutant X: The Grift
programme.desc: Brennans skyggefulle ekskjæreste henvender seg til ham for å få hjelp når hennes siste svindel tar en dødelig vending.

programme.title: Mutant X: At Destiny's End
programme.desc: Teamet står overfor sitt farligste oppdrag ennå: å stoppe en gruppe øko-terrorister.

programme.title: Mutant X: Within These Walls
programme.desc: Brennan er opprørt over Adam, som forteller ham at han ble betrodd å holde hemmeligheten og drar etter å ha snakket med den personen. Mannen leter etter noen og er villig til å drepe alle for å komme til den personen.

programme.title: Mutant X: Hard Time
programme.desc: Teamet går undercover for å undersøke uforklarlige dødsfall i fengselet.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: When the small community of Noel, Missouri discovered their bank was robbed, they're shocked. When the bank president turned up missing, they're outraged. And when clues began to surface the facts were more terrible than anyone could have guessed.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Driven to Kill
programme.desc: A serial rapist targeted women. His dark urges raged out of control and led him to murder. He followed a path so random it was impossible to trace, and all that tied him to his crimes were his access to the highways and a bizarre sexual fetish.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Secrets
programme.desc: Two young boys were the only witnesses to their mother's murder. The horrible crime appeared unmotivated, senseless and random.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Without Remorse
programme.desc: A small town without any crime was turned inside out by the arrival of one dangerous stranger. Some killers are cold and calculating; others are impulsive, unpredictable, and hard to pin down.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead Wrong
programme.desc: Hiding a body can be difficult; it's sometimes easier to obscure or disguise the circumstances of the death, turning murder into suicide, or pinning the blame on someone else. The truth is told through subtle clues taken from the crime scene.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Vanished
programme.desc: In New York, an ambitious college student has her whole life ahead of her, until she crosses the path of a killer. It's a random murder, the hardest kind to solve.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Blood
programme.desc: The forces of nature can reduce a body to bones in a matter of weeks. Using a unique combination of art and science, forensic anthropologists give victims a face long after they have been forgotten.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Dealings
programme.desc: For a price, anything's possible. Contract killings arose out of the need to establish the perfect alibi. By hiring someone else to do the dirty work, a person can deflect guilt, at least in theory.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: Wax Magic
programme.desc: An eccentric wax sculptor and his wife tour with a carnival. Not so coincidentally, a series of ax murders follow the carnival and the Hall of Horrors wax museum the sculptor runs.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: Better Off Dead
programme.desc: A doctor is trying to develop a cure for a childhood syndrome lending towards hyper violence. Due to his mistake, his daughter was inadvertently infected with the disease from a contaminated needle.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: The Butcher
programme.desc: While Micki and Ryan are on vacation, Jack has nightmares of his World War II experience when he was captured by the Nazis and nearly killed by Rausch, a commandant known as The Butcher.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: Crippled Inside
programme.desc: Fleeing fraternity boys who plan to attack her, a figure skater is hit by a car and crippled. However, a mysterious old man sells her an antique wheelchair at a garage sale.

programme.title: Isabelle
programme.desc: Isabelle tar opp arven fra 'Rosemary's Baby' og 'Eksorsisten'. Et vanlig amerikansk ektepar flytter inn i et perfekt villastrøk i New England. Men drømmen om å starte et lykkelig familieliv blir snart knust.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: A winding system of caves makes Kentucky one of the most unique geological wonders in the world. Near the caves is Bethlehem Academy, a long-abandoned Catholic School that is being kept alive by a unique resident.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: For nearly 200 years, the Jailer’s Inn housed prisoners, many of whom were involved in the city’s bustling Bourbon trade. The Team visits with the Inn’s manager to learn about notable inmates like Jesse James.

programme.title: Humanoids From The Deep
programme.desc: Scientific experiments backfire and produce horrific mutations: half man, half fish, which terrorize a small fishing village by killing the men and raping the women.

programme.title: The Tomb Of Ligeia
programme.desc: Vincent Price is a man haunted by his past. In this case, the past comes in the form of his now-deceased first wife Ligeia, who casts a shadow over an ill-advised second marriage, especially when Ligeia’s spirit returns in the form of a black cat.

programme.title: The Duellists
programme.desc: Keith Carradine og Harvey Keitel har hovedrollene i denne dramatiske filmen om to offiserer i Napoleons hær som møter hverandre på brutalt vis i en rekke dueller.

programme.title: Tilfellet Henry
programme.desc: Henry er en vellykket advokat som må vinne for enhver pris, selv på familiens bekostning. Men et pistolskudd setter en stopper for Henrys karriere, lammer ham og fjerner alle minner om livet han hadde før.

programme.title: Dragon Blade
programme.desc: Når den korrupte romerske lederen Tiberius med en stor hær forsøker å gjøre krav på Silkeveien, må Huo An og hans gruppe trente krigere alliere seg med en elitehær av romerske soldater ledet av general Lucius.

programme.title: Daredevil
programme.desc: Advokaten MattMurdock er blind, menhans resterende firesanser er overmenneskeligskarpe. Omdagen representererMurdock de undertrykte,men om natten er hanDaredevil.

programme.title: Chloe & Theo
programme.desc: Chloe, en ung kvinne som bor på gatene i New York, møter den kloke inuitten Theo, som har blitt sendt til New York av sine "eldste" for å levere et budskap til verden.

programme.title: Jackass Number Two
programme.desc: Forbered deg på ukontrollerbare latterkramper og kvalmebølger når gutta kaster sine forslåtte kropper inn i en rekke absurde situasjoner.Jackass Number Two det er en komedie du vil se igjen og igjen.

programme.title: Fisherman's Friends
programme.desc: I idylliske Port Isaac hører Danny tilfeldigvis koret Fisherman's Friends, bestående av ti ekte fiskere. Danny jobber for et plateselskap, og bestemmer seg for å signere koret, men å signere ti røffe fiskere viser seg å være lettere sagt en gjort.

programme.title: Official Secrets
programme.desc: Den sanne historien om en britisk varsler som lekket informasjon til media om en ulovlig NSA-operasjon, hvis formål var å presse FNs sikkerhetsråd til å godkjenne invasjonen av Irak i 2003.

programme.title: Red Dawn
programme.desc: Når en amerikansk by blir invadert av nordkoreanske soldater, kommer en gruppe unge mennesker sammen for å beskytte hverandre, frigjøre byen og gjenvinne sin frihet.

programme.title: Taken
programme.desc: Den tidligere agenten Bryan Mills begynner de lengste 96 timene i sitt liv når han tar opp jakten på mennene som kidnappet datteren hans.

programme.title: Vampire Zombies From Space!
programme.desc: Fra verdensrommets dyp har Dracula laget sin ondeste plan hittil: å forvandle Marlow til en hær av vampyr-zombier. En broket gruppe helter må kjempe for å redde verden.

programme.title: Tetsuo II: Body Hammer
programme.desc: Tre år etter Metal Fetisjistens forvandling ser kontorarbeideren Taniguchi Tomoo verden falle sammen når skinheads kidnapper sønnen hans. Tvunget til å frigjøre sin destruktive kraft, forvandles han til en grusom symbiose av metall og vev.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: The Reel Thing
programme.desc: Arbeidet som konsulenter for en arkeologisk eventyrfilm, innser Sydney og Nigel at farao Amun IIs 'rekvisitter' er ekte, lenge tenkte tapte relikvier. Hvordan kan de være?

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Out of the Past
programme.desc: Claudia oppdager at hun var Cleopatras tjener i et tidligere liv da hun opplever déjà vu mens hun så på en katalog fra en antikkegyptisk relikvieutstilling.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Eyes of Toklamanee

programme.desc: I ett anfall av sjuklig svartsjuka förgiftar den kompromisslösa och förföriska konstnären Ingrid sin älskare. Hon döms till livstids fängelse och hennes 15-åriga dotter Astrid får därefter flytta runt mellan olika fosterfamiljer.

programme.title: Boulevard: Boulevard
programme.desc: En tråkig bankman (Robin Williams) utmanas när han oväntat tar en ny riktning i livet och väljer kärleken.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In this special episode, we take a closer look at cases previously featured on this series. Our goal is to explore more fully some of the investigative methods and techniques that have made the FBI the premier law enforcement agency in the world.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1980s, the United States faced a deadly new enemy abroad, an expanding network of terrorists targeting American interests. Hundreds of innocent people were killed in bombings, executions, and hijackings.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Takeover
programme.desc: Two armed bank robbers hit a Seattle bank taking over 150,000 dollars. Before they can escape police confront them and the pair splits up. As authorities search block by block they learn one was a career criminal with a long history of violence.

programme.title: I morgon börjar allt
programme.desc: Samuel, en man vars bekymmerslösa liv på Franska Rivieran vänds upp och ner när Kristin, som han haft en kortare romans med, plötsligt dyker upp och presenterar honom för deras nyfödda dotter Gloria. Kristin överlämnar Gloria med varm hand i hans vårdnad.

programme.title: Taken 3
programme.desc: Liam Neeson är tillbaka som Bryan Mills. Men denna gång är det han själv som hamnar i knipa då han blir jagad för ett mord han inte begått.

programme.title: TAKEN
programme.desc: Bryan, en före detta CIA-agent har svårt att släppa sin gamla yrkesroll och ser faror överallt. När hans dotter, Kim, åker till Paris, besannas hans värsta mardröm, hon kidnappas.

programme.title: Mitt namn är fortfarande Nobody
programme.desc: Terence Hill har fått miljoner svenska biobesökare att jubla! Först kom Trinity, sedan Nobody. Nu är Terence Hill tillbaka som Joe Thanks, den galnaste och snabbaste revolvermannen i vilda västern.

programme.title: Poupelle of Chimney Town
programme.desc: Poupelle från Chimney Town är berättelsen om den unge Lubicchi som lever bland denU+000Atjocka röken från skorstenarna i sin isolerade stad och längtar efter att se “stjärnorna” veta sanningen som hans far alltid berättat om för honom

programme.title: Andromeda: Den oövervinneliga mannen
programme.desc: Den utspelar sig i ett alternativt universum där Dylan dog och Gaheris Rhade försöker reformera Samväldet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Delenda Est
programme.desc: Gruppen som attackerade Andromeda under det första undertecknandet av Samväldets stadgar återvänder för att ställa till med mer förödelse.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det mörka bakåt
programme.desc: Trance går igenom ett antal olika scenarier och försöker hitta ett där hennes besättningskamrater inte dör.

programme.title: Mutant X: Ingen utfart
programme.desc: En mutant som har förmågan att interfasera med vilken dator som helst med sitt sinne, som är förlamad efter ett möte med teamet, tar över Sanctuarys datorer.

programme.title: Mutant X: Väktare

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Without A Trace

programme.title: The New Detectives: For Love Or Money

programme.title: The New Detectives: Left At The Scene
programme.desc: The tiniest residue left at the scene can become a mark of distinction in the most singular and intimate of ways.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Witness To Terror
programme.desc: Black Boxes: Little evidence is left after an airplane takes a deadly plunge from the sky. Investigators' best hope for an answer comes from the flight data recorder known as a black box.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Brandon, Mustafa, Malia, and Kevin engage in a roundtable discussion highlighting their most shocking finds and new data that they’ve gathered across their numerous investigations.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Benham, Kentucky’s idyllic, small-town aesthetic belies its dark and bloody past, rife with greed and conflict. There are many who believe the community is living under the shadow of a mountain that bore witness to an evil supernatural occurrence.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Further immersing themselves into Harlan county, the team investigates an active coal mine, Portal 31, and speaks with its manager about his own paranormal claims both inside the mine and in Lynch, Kentucky.

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Haunted Mill – Part 1
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Stockport and investigate an abandoned Mill, Weir Mill, said to the most haunted Mill in the UK. Demonic figures haunt anyone that enters. Will the team survive the night with the spirits?

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Haunted Mill – Part 2
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters continue their investigation of Weir Mill and the search for paranormal activity takes a darker turn. Will they finally uncover the truth behind the buildings dark hauntings?

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: The Ape
programme.desc: A mad scientist trying to cure polio must obtain human spinal fluid, and resorts to nefarious means by wearing an ape suit to procure victims for his experiment without being detected.

programme.title: The Devil Bat
programme.desc: Dr. Paul Carruthers is cheated by his employers after developing a new aftershave lotion, so he seeks revenge by using a giant killer bat to kill anyone wearing the lotion.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: En inspirerande berättelse om basketcoachen Ken Carter, som fick både kritik och beröm när han skapade rubriker efter att han bänkat hela sitt obesegrade lag på grund av deras dåliga studieresultat.

programme.title: Paterson
programme.desc: Paterson (Adam Driver) är busschaufför i staden Paterson, New Jersey. Varje dag kör han sin dagliga rutt under vilken han observerar staden när den flimrar förbi genom vindrutan och lyssnar samtidigt på fragment av passagerarnas konversationer.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A criminal who kills a police officer wages war on society. In 1987 such a criminal vanished after shooting two Boston officers, one fatally. He had a history of violence against cops and the protection of a group of outlaws.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programme.desc: A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Terror In Disguise
programme.desc: Banks use a variety of devices to discourage would-be robbers: security cameras, silent alarms, and exploding dye packs. But when an elusive bank robber targeted Seattle's banks, none of these precautions were effective.

programme.title: The FBI Files: First and Kennedy Street Crew
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, Washington, D.C., became the murder capital of the nation. Few were left untouched by gang violence, which was ignited by the drug trade. By 1994, that violence would strike at the very heart of law enforcement.

programme.title: Jackass: The Movie
programme.desc: Med scener som aldrig skulle visas i TV! Stollarna från MTV-serien "Jackass" är tillbaka med stuntsm som ingen skulle låta dem göra i TV.

programme.title: A Breath Of Scandal
programme.desc: Den vackra Sophia Loren är den österrikiska prinsessan som, trots sin exil från familjegården, föraktar sin mors önskan att gifta sig med en prins.

programme.title: The Big White
programme.desc: För att lindra sina ekonomiska problem söker en anställd på en resebyrå efter ett fruset lik, som råkar vara eftertraktat av två mördare.

programme.title: Till Death
programme.desc: Efter en romantisk kväll i deras hus nere vid sjön vaknar Emma fängslad vid sin döde man. Avskuren från allt mitt i vintern måste hon värja sig mot lejda mördare för att kunna undfly sin mans sjuka plan.

programme.title: Supersnutarna
programme.desc: Matt och Wilbur är två hårdslående bråkmakare, men med hjärtat på rätta stället. Efter ett misslyckat rånförsök i Miami hamnar de av misstag på stadens polisskola.

programme.title: Fantomen
programme.desc: Historien börjar när en expedition anländer till ön Bengalia, på jakt efter Iskulls of Touganda. De tros gömma mäktiga krafter och kan utgöra slutet för mänskligheten.

programme.title: Mutant X: Möjligheter
programme.desc: Brennan och Mutant X-teamet går samman med en tidsresande mutant för att desarmera en bomb som hotar att få förödande konsekvenser.

programme.title: Mutant X: Konspirationsteori
programme.desc: Medan Brennan och Shalimar undersöker en mystisk flygolycka funderar Lexa på sin framtid i Mutant X-teamet.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Arthurs kors
programme.desc: Scotland Yard kallar Sidney och Nigel för att identifiera ett mordvapen från 500-talet. Det visar sig vara kung Arthurs gravkors, men förutom offret letar flera andra efter det.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Faux räv
programme.desc: När Nigel charmas av den briljanta studenten Lorraine och visar henne deras kontor (och kysser henne), slår en inbrottstjuv ut Sidney, men vad blev stulet?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Obsessions
programme.desc: Some people will let nothing stand between them and their goals. In their tortured minds, raw desire replaces all reason, and homicide becomes a convenient means to an end.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Dosage
programme.desc: Toxicology: While drugs can cure disease and ease pain, they can also be agents of murder. Toxicologists can examine blood and tissue to uncover cases where death is not as natural as it may seemfrom slow arsenic poisoning to quick cocaine overdoses.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Impressions
programme.desc: 911 receives a desperate call in Fort Worth, Texas. A man's wife is shot. Forensic investigators search for clues in unlikely places, hoping the victim herself could provide information needed to determine how and why she died.

programme.title: The New Detectives: False Witness
programme.desc: When a murder is committed and deceit clouds the evidence, investigators turn to science and technology to uncover the truth and expose a murderous lie and capture the killer.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Long Distance Call

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Man in the Bottle

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Jeopardy Room

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Four O'Clock

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Mind and the Matter

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Invaders

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Thing About Machines

programme.desc: A man discovers a cursed trefinator in a museum warehouse: a device that transfers intelligence, the man uses it to make himself intelligent.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Bulkeley Hotel
programme.desc: The former home of Queen Victoria is now home to many spirits who have been seen by guests and staff. Witness the first ever formal documentation of the paranormal activities in the Bulkeley Hotel.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Plas Teg
programme.desc: The county of Flintshire in Wales is said to be a land filled with ghosts and haunts. Plas Teg is said to be one of the "most haunted" houses in the area. With over 400 years of history, this place is sure to be the home of many an entity.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The DuPonts made their mark on America with a literal bang: Eleuthere DuPont built his family’s fortune with gunpowder. The sprawling family mansion in Old Louisville is the site of a scandalous murder that was covered up for decades.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: One of Kentucky’s most famed para-tourist destinations, the Museum was once a Civil War hospital, and many believe that its uniquely strategic location has contributed to the persistent hauntings.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The Glasgow Kentucky Bed & Breakfast is home to one of the most startling finds the team has ever experienced, and they return to fulfill a promise they made to the building’s former owner.

programme.title: White Zombie
programme.desc: A plantation owner desires another man's bride and enlists the help of a witch doctor to use a mind-control potion to make her fall in love with him. Instead, the witch doctor turns against them both.

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: The Raven (1963)
programme.desc: The sorcerer Craven learns from fellow magician Dr. Bedlo that his supposedly dead wife is alive and living at the castle of master sorcerer Dr. Scarabus. The film is presented without local subtitles.

programme.title: Tully
programme.desc: En ny dramakomedi från teamet bakom Juno med Charlize Theron i huvudrollen som Marlo.

programme.title: Wonder Wheel
programme.desc: ”Wonder Wheel” är berättelsen om fyra människor vars liv sammanflätas på Coney Islands legendariska nöjesfält.

programme.title: The FBI Files: No Remorse
programme.desc: A burning body in a dark alley shed light on a cold-blooded killer. His partners in crime would tell the story, if they lived. In the underworld of the drug trade, even a childhood friend can quickly become an enemy.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Silent Strike
programme.desc: Money may not be the root of all evil, but for some men, a million dollars is enough to justify murder. Even men sworn to uphold the law can sometimes be tempted.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1980s, the drug trade in New York City was a nightmare. Dealers made millions. Street violence was out of control. The NYPD battled the drug gangs only to become their target.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Etna, New Hampshire is a small town. It's the kind of place where people trust their neighbors and leave their doors unlocked. A double murder shattered that trust and left the entire community terrified.

programme.title: Disaster Movie
programme.desc: Disaster movie' följer de komiska missödena av några sjukt snygga 20-åringar under en ödesdiger natt då de försöker att komma i säkerhet undan alla naturkatastrofer som finns.

programme.title: Summer Rental
programme.desc: Carl Reiner (The Jerk) regisserade denna berättelse om John Candy som en familjefar som tar semester från sunt förnuft när han hyr ett sommarhus i Florida.

programme.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy

programme.title: Long Weekend
programme.desc: Peter (John Hargreaves) and Marcia (Briony Behets), a bitter married couple teetering on the edge of divorce, take a camping trip to heal the rift between them. As the weekend progresses, the selfish pair engage in reckless behavior that demonstrates an increasing disrespect for their natural surroundings. When Peter and Marcia become the targets of a series of inexplicable animal attacks, it becomes clear that an angry Mother Nature has come to exact her revenge.

programme.title: Fade To Black [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A shy, lonely film buff embarks on a killing spree against those who browbeat and betray him, all the while stalking his idol, a Marilyn Monroe lookalike.

programme.title: Living Dark: The Story of Ted the Caver
programme.desc: Two estranged brothers become obsessed with gaining access to an unexplored cave, despite the horrors they encounter during their excavation.

programme.title: Spiders 2
programme.desc: Alexandra (Stephanie Niznik) and Jason (Greg Cromer) are a married couple whose yacht fails to withstand a storm at sea. They're saved from the stormy waters by Capt. Bigelow (Daniel Quinn) and his crew, who man a cargo ship. Jason is heavily drugged by the ship's doctor, Gerbac (Richard Moll), and realizes something is amiss when he comes across corpses. Meanwhile, Gerbac is working on a dangerous scientific experiment using spider eggs, which he hopes to implant in Jason's body.

programme.title: Hush (2016) [B&W Shush Cut] [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A deaf and mute writer who retreated into the woods to live a solitary life must fight for her life in silence when a masked killer appears at her window.

programme.title: A Fantastic Fear Of Everything [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A crime novelist whose research on Victorian serial killers has turned him into a paranoid wreck must confront his worst fears when a film executive takes a sudden interest in his movie script.

programme.title: Megaboa
programme.desc: On a trip to Colombia, a group of college students heads into the rainforest to look for cave drawings. Instead, they find a 50-foot boa constrictor.

programme.title: The Exorcist III: Legion (Director's Cut) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Police Lt. Kinderman (George C. Sam changed careers after making a name for himself as one of Denver's premier sports journalists. programme.title: Philippa Perry On Why Everyone Has an Inner Critic
programme.desc: Psychotherapist and author Philippa Perry discusses why everyone has an inner critic and how to stop believing yours. Philippa explains why not feeling 'good enough' is often less about truth and more about habit. She shares how to tell the difference between a helpful critical inner voice and a self-sabotaging one, and why negative thought patterns keep us stuck.

programme.title: Sam Thompson On His Anxiety And Undiagnosed ADHD
programme.desc: Sam Thompson discusses how anxiety and undiagnosed ADHD have shaped his relationships and self-confidence. He shares his experience of panic attacks, including one on the first day of I'm A Celebrity, and talks about therapy, the patterns he kept repeating, and his three go-to people during crises. Sam and Fearne debate people-pleaser approaches to leaving parties and discuss behind-the-scenes stories from his content creation work. Sam also reveals why he was willing to pay to appear on I'm A Celebrity.

programme.title: Sam Claflin Asks What Is Body Dysmorphia?
programme.desc: Actor Sam Claflin discusses his lifelong struggle with body dysmorphia and body image with Fearne Cotton. Sam explains what having body dysmorphia means to him and how it affects everything from the food he eats to his willingness to watch his own films back. Fearne and Sam discuss being chronic people pleasers and how they're working to stop putting everyone else's comfort before their own. Sam reflects on how he was brought up to think about masculinity and what he's doing to ensure his own son grows up with gentler male role models. They also reminisce about the early days of MSN and webcam chatrooms.

programme.title: Chris Appleton: From Being Bullied to Styling the Kardashians
programme.desc: Celebrity hair stylist Chris Appleton chats with Fearne about why we change our hair when we want to start over. Chris explains that everyone from the Kardashians to cancer patients have opened up to him about their insecurities, and he's seen the profound impact that looking more like yourself on the outside can have on how you feel about yourself on the inside. He's fascinated by the self-limiting beliefs people have about who they are. Chris has dealt with a lot of his own shame and fears too. He was bullied at school, struggled to acknowledge his sexuality, and had huge imposter syndrome when he first arrived in Hollywood. He also gives Fearne a consultation about going bolder with her hair. Content warning: this episode contains frank conversation about suicidal ideation.

programme.title: Jimmy Carr on Feminism, Parenting, and Success
programme.desc: Comedian Jimmy Carr discusses defining success without comparing yourself to others, the importance of hard work, and why he doesn't fear cancel culture. He explains his views on feminism and motherhood, why he refuses to use the term "babysitting" for parenting his own children, and how his anxieties fuel his comedy.

programme.title: Nafessa Williams On Racism, Sexism, and Rivals
programme.desc: Rivals actress Nafessa Williams discusses playing the only black woman in a white man's world in 1980s Britain, and how she sees her acting as her contribution to activism and representation. She explores what it means to be on a TV show with intimate scenes, the journey from law to acting, manifestation and taking action, faith and optimism, and the importance of rest alongside ambition.
